written: 2026-11-21, before any fold, alignment or structure readout of the tested proteins; selection by code/n07_select.py (seed 17)
question: Does a candidate protein of the lut / xoxF neighborhoods carry a conserved multidentate carboxylate metal site of the kind the known lanthanide-binding proteins carry, at positive-control rates and above the negative-control rates?
prior_facts_used_to_fix_the_rule: Lanthanide-binding project, PDB benchmark of 879 lanthanide sites (2026-11-09): the fraction of candidate centers holding a lanthanide is 0.10 at three reachable Asp/Glu, 0.46 at four, 0.65 at five; on ESMFold2 models the count ranks sites and fails as a hard cutoff at pLDDT < 70; lanmodulin, lanpepsy and LanD model sites hold 4-6, XoxF and PedH sites hold 3 (cofactor-assisted).
Same project (2026-11-09): a protein-wide maximum of the acidic count ranks composition (median percentile 0.66 in a composition-matched null); the site-level score is the informative one.

Same project (2026-11-09): ESMFold2 co-folds give identical donor counts for La and Ca in 49 of 55 EF-hand proteins, lanmodulin crystal controls included; co-fold coordination carries no lanthanide-versus-calcium information. The Biohub API accepts CCD ions LA and CA.

proteins.families: rescue3 tokens (MMseqs2 families of the frozen run) for every tested protein

positives_reference.lanpepsy_Q1H2G7: Methylobacillus flagellatus, public sequence (experimental_ln_proteins_2026-11-09/ln_proteins.faa); structure test only (no collection family)
positives_reference.Hans_LanM_A0A4V2JDD3: Hansschlegelia quercus, public sequence; structure test only

proteins.negatives_A_calcium: Pfam calcium-binding classes (EF-hand, Excalibur, TSP_3, hemolysin-type Ca-binding, Calx-beta, dockerin, FG-GAP/VCBS), 80-320 aa, lut-carrying genomes, lanM token excluded; up to 3 tokens per class
proteins.negatives_B_unannotated: no Pfam row in the protein or its token, no slot label, outside every lut and xoxF window, lut-carrying genomes, 10 tokens per length bin 90-140 / 140-190 / 190-300 aa
proteins.representatives: up to 6 per candidate or collection-positive family (M. extorquens representative first, then one per genus by genus member count, length 0.8-1.25x family median; xoxF 3), 1 per negative family
proteins.family_alignment: one member per genome, at most 150, mafft --auto; columns mapped to the representative

T_seq.conserved_acidic_column: gap fraction <= 0.20 and D or E in >= 0.80 of the non-gap residues
T_seq.report: conserved acidic columns per 100 representative residues; family D+E fraction; EF-hand loop patterns (site_cn.py regexes of the lanthanide project: strict and relaxed 12-residue loops), lanmodulin-type Pro at loop position 2 and loop spacing; PepSY domains (Pfam); XoxF Ln-coordinating Asp (AM1 XoxF1 Asp320 equivalent) for the dehydrogenase only
T_seq.role: descriptive plus input to T_struct conservation

T_struct.model: ESMFold2 fast (Biohub, fold endpoint), single chain, full-length sequence including any signal peptide
T_struct.centers: 0.7 A grid points with no protein heavy atom within 2.0 A and >= 2 carboxylate oxygens within 3.2 A
T_struct.reach: Asp or Glu reaches a center if its carboxyl carbon (Asp CG, Glu CD) lies within 4.2 A, or its preceding carbon (Asp CB, Glu CG) within 5.2 A
T_struct.site_pLDDT: minimum CA pLDDT of the reaching residues
T_struct.score_struct: max over centers with site_pLDDT >= 70 of the number of distinct reaching Asp/Glu
T_struct.score_cons: max over centers with site_pLDDT >= 70 of the number of reaching residues at conserved acidic columns (T_seq)
T_struct.also_reported: Asn/Gln side-chain O and backbone O within 3.0 A of the best center; fold neighbors by Foldseek (local PDB copy) and TM-score (US-align, biotite login node) to experimental lanthanide-protein structures 8FNS (Mex-LanM, Nd), 8DQ2 (Hans-LanM, La), 9VY4 (lanpepsy), 6OC5 (XoxF1, La) and 1CLL (calmodulin, Ca)

tests.T_crystal_check: the center finder (pLDDT criterion dropped, all residues treated as conserved) on 8FNS, 8DQ2, 1CLL and 9VY4 with metals removed must place a center of capacity >= 4 within 2.0 A of >= 50% of the protein-bound metal positions

T_cofold.model: ESMFold2 all-atom (Biohub fold_all_atom), --ligand LA:2 and separately --ligand CA:2
T_cofold.who: top 2 representatives per candidate family by score_cons (then score_struct), 2 per collection-positive family (lanM, LanD), both public references, every negative A, the 10 negatives B with the highest score_struct; xoxF is excluded (its site needs PQQ)
T_cofold.readout: per ion: protein O/N donors within 3.0 A, chelating carboxylates (both O within 3.0 A), distinct carboxylate residues, metal-O distances, mean pLDDT of donor residues; overlap of its carboxylate residues with the apo best center's reaching residues
T_cofold.PASS_cofold: in the LA co-fold one ion has >= 5 protein O donors from >= 3 distinct Asp/Glu, and >= 3 of those Asp/Glu are reaching residues of the apo best center
T_cofold.lanthanide_vs_calcium: LA and CA co-folds compared descriptively only; no co-fold metric calls lanthanide preference

T_context.source: code/n05_context.py (presence by rescue3 tokens; lut-carrying vs same-genus lut-negative genomes; Mantel-Haenszel OR over genera; permutation of lut status within genus, 2,000 draws) and code/n06_xoxf_neighborhood.py (+-8 genes of K23995 genes)
T_context.PASS_context: matched-genus MH OR >= 5 with permutation p <= 0.01, or the family lies within +-8 genes of >= 20% of K23995 genes

criteria: positives lanM + LanD representatives and the two public references: PASS_site in >= 2/3
pilot_gate.on_failure: the assay is reported uninformative; no candidate verdict rests on it (Frame-Challenge Gate)
pilot_gate.known_blind_spot: xoxF (cofactor-assisted site with three carboxylates) is expected to fail PASS_site; it is reported, not gated

verdicts.SUPPORTED_metal_site: PASS_site in >= 50% of the family's representatives, PASS_cofold in >= 1, PASS_context, family score_cons above negatives B (one-sided Mann-Whitney p <= 0.05), and the pilot gate passed. Lanthanide over calcium stays UNVERIFIED unless a class-specific lanthanide feature is present (lanmodulin loop features; XoxF Ln-Asp); if negatives A pass PASS_site at >= 50%, the reading is 'conserved metal site, consistent with Ca or Ln'.
verdicts.WEAK: PASS_site in >= 1 but < 50% of representatives, or PASS_site without PASS_cofold, or PASS_context fails
verdicts.KILLED: PASS_site in 0 representatives (no conserved center of >= 4 carboxylates at pLDDT >= 70)

naming: OBSERVED (sites, residues, counts, co-occurrence) is kept apart from NAMED; a passing candidate is 'consistent with a metal-binding periplasmic protein'; no lanthanide-binding name without a measured binding constant in the literature
